notes:
update rollout!
0.11.7.0
- Player skill tree redone: 26 skills in 10 blocks. Old points are given back once.
- Classes: the Operator and the Demolitioner reworked, every extension passive of both now works. Bigger Charges also helps the rest of the team.
- Heavy: Fire at will is an aura round the Heavy with a dashed ring: you have the bonus while you stand inside it.
- Scavenger: Ransack speeds up searches, terminals and the vault.
- New items: Molotov, Stims, Prototype Shield, Prototype Cloak and the Auto Revival Tool.
- New debuff: Maimed halves your attack speed, cured by the Arm Sling.
- Burning stacks up to 4 times. Surges follow the spawn cap. The hive node now blocks zombies' paths.
- The Assault Rifle fires every 0.25 s.
- A hero at the top level passes its XP on to the lowest teammate. The lobby shows your own XP for the run.
- A failed update now says why and offers the download page.
